assets.imagegen_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: construction financing website illustration
Input image: reference crop only; generate a new standalone production asset from it, not a crop conversion.
Primary request: Generate a polished standalone monochrome architectural construction illustration for Fairlend construction draw financing. Preserve the reference composition and subject: compact narrow residential infill build, roughly three storeys plus lower level, at rough framing and sheathing stage before exterior facade installation.
Scene/backdrop: warm off-white paper field, clean website-ready asset, no UI chrome.
Subject: small residential build with raw sheathing, exposed framing visible through open window/door bays, roof guardrails, temporary stairs, modest lumber stacks, small site footprint.
Style/medium: refined black ink linework and graphite wash, premium architectural sketch, crisp technical detail with airy negative space.
Composition/framing: horizontal web asset, building centered, full structure visible, modest neighboring mass outlines acceptable only if faint and secondary.
Construction sequencing constraints: facades come last; this asset must show pre-facade rough construction. No finished facade materials, no brick cladding, no stone cladding, no siding, no final glazing/window system, no completed entry door, no polished landscaping.
Avoid: high-rise scale, tower cranes, heavy equipment, workers, cars, text, logos, labels, progress timeline elements, watermarks, collage layout.
